title: Understanding the Minimum Wage in NSW: From Hourly Rate to Annual Salary and Fortnightly Pay
description: Learn how to convert the minimum wage in NSW to annual, fortnightly, and weekly pay. Includes tax, super, and casual loading for a 38-hour week.

faqs.q: How do I calculate annual salary from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by hours per week (usually 38) then by 52 weeks. For the minimum wage in NSW: $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,269.44 per year.

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Hourly Pay to Annual Salary for a 38-Hour Week

If you earn an hourly wage, understanding your annual salary is straightforward: multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52 weeks. For full-time employees, the standard is 38 hours per week, as set by the Fair Work Commission. This article uses that assumption unless stated otherwise.

### The Minimum Wage in NSW

The **minimum wage in NSW** is the national minimum wage determined by the Fair Work Commission. From 1 July 2026, it is $26.44 per hour. For a 38-hour week, that equates to $1,004.90 per week. Over 52 weeks, the annual gross pay is approximately $52,270. This is before tax and superannuation.

Remember, the national minimum wage applies to employees not covered by an award or agreement. Many industries have higher award rates. Check your [pay guides](/blog) for specific rates.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many employers pay fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross, multiply your weekly pay by two. For the minimum wage in NSW, that is $2,009.80 per fortnight. This can help with budgeting.

### Casual Loading

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base rate. For the minimum wage, that is $33.05 per hour. When using [the timesheet](/), you can check the "casual loading" box to add 25% to the base rate you enter. Do not enter a rate that already includes casual loading.

### Tax and Super

Your take-home pay depends on tax and the Medicare levy. For 2026–27, the resident tax rates are: nil up to $18,200, 15% from $18,201 to $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, and 45% above that. Medicare is generally 2% (using 2025–26 single reduction thresholds as 2026–27 thresholds are not confirmed). Superannuation is paid on top at 12% of ordinary earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830.

For the minimum wage in NSW, annual super is about $6,272 (12% of $52,270). This is not deducted from your pay; it goes into your super fund.

### Average Earnings in NSW

For context, the Australian Bureau of Statistics reports that full-time adult ordinary time earnings in New South Wales averaged $2,108.80 per week in May 2026. That is an average, not a median for any specific job. Your pay may differ.

### Using the Calculator

Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool helps you see annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures. Remember the assumptions: no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. The estimate is a guide.

[Reference tables](/data) provide more detail on tax brackets and super caps.
